label: MRtrix3 fixel2tsf
description:
Map fixel values to a track scalar file based on an input tractogram
This command is useful for visualising all brain fixels (e.g. the output from fixelcfestats) in 3D.

parameters.label: angle
parameters.description: the max anglular threshold for computing correspondence between a fixel direction and track tangent (default = 45 degrees)
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

parameters.label: quiet
parameters.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

input_slots.label: fixel_in
input_slots.description: the input fixel data file (within the fixel directory)

output_slots.label: tsf
output_slots.description: the output track scalar file This generic file port does not establish a specialized scientific artifact type; downstream use must match the documented contents, not merely the filename extension.
